findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arthur_list_transactions, arthur_get_transaction · Private data: arthur_list_tenants, arthur_get_tenant, arthur_create_unit_task · Public sink: arthur_create_unit_task, arthur_add_task_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arthur_list_transactions, arthur_get_transaction · Private data: arthur_list_tenants, arthur_get_tenant, arthur_create_unit_task · Public sink: arthur_create_unit_task, arthur_add_task_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
